frames.narration: Alright, everyone, this is the briefing for Period ten, week three, District eight. The week totals thirty-one hours across fourteen sets. Details are on screen, checkpoints come along the way, and the checkpoints do count.

frames.title: This Week at a Glance
frames.narration: Here is the whole week on one screen. Grocery carries three sets, Health Beauty Care carries five, fresh carries five, and Natural Foods carries one. The largest set is Natural Foods Chips and Snacks at six hours, followed by Frozen Meatless and Deodorants at four hours each. Six sets run cold, and every cold set has a twenty-minute limit on product out of refrigeration.

frames.narration: Three callouts. First, the new Kroger shelf strip format starts this week. Strips now carry a shelf number and an item position number. Review the format before installing. Where a section has no room for the extra numbers, spices for example, the shelf number drops and the position number moves into the item information. Second, trial size sets and mobility racks are non-Compass events. Remind the store to sign them out, or they come back as byway issues. Third, hold any fishing strips. Fishing moved to next week, and nothing gets loaded this week.
